verdict.rationale: Asking whether a SaaS financial-planning product publishes its source under an open license is a fair question, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions a source repository, an open-source license or public code. The ability to open and inspect the financial Model is about user data transparency, not product source, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
